djzc.wiki_bzb_1: Nuclear Trooper: A One-Way Ticket in a Virtual World
djzc.wiki_bzb_2: Replacing the original "Banzai" class with the "Nuclear" class is our most significant decision. It's not just a name change — it's a shift from echoes of militarism to a reflection on China's nuclear history. Every takeoff with the "Wings of Q-5" becomes a parallel simulation of that era. Descriptions, system messages, and sound effects have all been revised. The Nuclear class is no longer a "madman's toy" — it has become a "witness to history."
djzc.wiki_bzb_3: Why was the Banzai class changed, while others remained untouched? Because it touches a sensitive and profound theme: sacrifice and destruction.
djzc.wiki_bzb_4: The original Banzai class exchanged sacrifice for lethality — the cruelest trade-off in war. The developers softened it with self-mockery. But the Nuclear class in Red Loong Pack points to a bomb that was "never actually dropped" — the cornerstone of national security, and the Sword of Damocles over humanity's fate. We may simulate destruction in games, but no one knows better than us how precious peace truly is.
